fusions.name: Clamped Roll
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. You clamp onto it and roll, dealing 24 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Ambush Lash
fusions.desc: Whips your tail through a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 28 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Wait, Short Snap
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds. You have 6% physical resistance.
